description: Maharashtra government will constitute an expert committee within 30 days to prepare SOPs for Artificial Intelligence use, Minister Yogesh Kadam told the Assembly. The panel will study risks like AI-enabled surveillance and facial recognition misuse. Its recommendations will be sent to the Centre for a national framework.
body_lead: Mumbai: The Maharashtra government on Tuesday announced that it will constitute an expert committee within the next 30 days to prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), while assuring the Assembly that the panel's recommendations would be forwarded to the Centre for framing a nationwide legal framework on AI.
